boundary: Exact immutable definition reads and generic component negotiation across declared domain registrations. Schema admission is separate from an installed examiner or executor; unavailable capability does not invalidate a valid Project. Existing immutable history owners preserve the original basis. This does not certify missing native writing interpretation/third-type examiners, new model roles, proposed commands, or overall A1.

review.perspective: Challenge substitution, ambiguity and false availability rather than replay normal loading: use authenticated foreign or stale reads, canonical byte mismatch, ambiguous installed examiners, malformed native payloads, and a real equal-content later definition revision. Require original candidates and original model-input manifests to retain their interpretation.

findings.finding: The graph compared only definition content hashes, so a later revision with identical content could silently appear current.
findings.resolution: Compare definition identity, revision and content hash; a real retained candidate remains stale after an equal-content additive revision and its original fields and definition are preserved.

findings.finding: Native examiner selection relied on schema alone and named unregistered Claim versions; the browser also lacked the installed writing requirement validator.
findings.resolution: Select through the exact definition and installed contract hash, register the actual browser native validator, deny stale and foreign payloads, and remove nonexistent schema version choices.

findings.finding: Choosing the first matching installed component concealed ambiguity.
findings.resolution: Exclude ambiguous capabilities and report a precise limitation without rejecting the valid Project.
